content:
alex: FYI during the canary we hit a case where high-tier tenant A preempted mid-request for tenant B and B's inference failed with 503.
maria: ugh. details? request size/seq length?
alex: short seq; problem was eviction triggered when A's burst exceeded soft quota. Preemption killed B's in-flight slot. We expected graceful drain.
raj: is this the `soft_preemptive` handler not honoring `grace_window_ms`? I've seen the code bail early if KV cache pinned.
maria: sounds like regression from preemptive-shim refactor — it now cancels rather than wait for finish.
sara: proposal: don't cancel in-flight requests unless they exceed grace_time + kill_threshold, and switch to background eviction queue. :thinking_face: 
mike: agree. also add metric `preempt_kills{reason}` and tag with tenant/route so we can correlate.
alex: +1 on metrics. we also need deterministic order: high-priority should preempt low-priority only at request boundary, not mid-actor.
raj: what about long-lived streaming responses? we should offer per-route `drain_policy` with options `finish`, `pause`, `cancel`.
maria: `pause` would buffer the tail tokens — risk OOM. maybe `pause` with a max buffer size and fallback to `cancel`.
sara: example config idea:
```
preemption:
  mode: soft
  grace_window_ms: 250
  kill_threshold_ms: 1000
  streaming: pause
  max_buffer_tokens: 1024
```

mike: test matrix: short sync, long stream, KV pinned, quantized model (fast/slow). We need unit + e2e sims.
infra-bot: perf-canary deployment: 2026-03-18T14:12Z started for region us-west-2
alex: who wants to own the RFC follow-up (impl + telemetry + sim)?
raj: I can take the shim changes + tests.
maria: I'll add telemetry events + Grafana panels; also alert if preempt_kills > 1% of requests for a tenant.
sara: I'll draft RFC patch for route-level `drain_policy` and add simulation harness changes.
mike: can we add chaos test that injects bursty high-priority traffic and ensure no in-flight cancels? (k8s pod killers?)
alex: yes add to release checklist. target branch: `preempt-refactor/v1`. timeline: aim for small canary next week.
sara: putting a short follow-up doc in the arch folder after RFC. thanks all :pray: 
maria: one more: ensure Dedicated vs Hosted behavior parity; dedicated customers may expect stricter hard-preempt.
alex: noted — include policy flavor in RFC (hosted: soft by default; dedicated: opt-in hard preempt).
raj: ok I'll open PRs and link them here.
mike: thx
